name: Datadog
what: Observability platform; acquired Adaptive ML (post-training), the exit comp for Q15.

name: NVIDIA
what: Dominant AI accelerator vendor; its inference software (Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, NIM) is the main absorption risk for serving startups.

name: CoreWeave
what: Largest neocloud; benchmark for GPU capacity, pricing and power procurement.

name: Emerald AI
what: Platform that lets AI data centers adjust power consumption to grid conditions by orchestrating training and inference loads, turning them into flexible grid assets and unlocking capacity on existing grid infrastructure.

name: GridCARE
what: Power Acceleration service (Energize platform) that uses AI models, grid simulations and real-time system intelligence to find and activate latent capacity in existing power infrastructure, cutting the time to bring large AI facilities online.

name: Baseten
what: Inference cloud for open and custom models (benchmark for the neutral-inference-cloud world).

name: Fireworks AI
what: Inference cloud for open and custom models (benchmark for the neutral-inference-cloud world).

name: Gimlet Labs
what: Serverless inference for AI agents and multi-agent systems; kforge autonomously generates optimized low-level kernels from PyTorch across hardware backends; research on dynamic scheduling and orchestration of AI workloads to hit performance and cost targets.

name: Sail Research
what: Inference platform for long-horizon AI agents: API for cost-efficient inference and deployment of open-source models, with customizable completion windows, drop-in API compatibility, and support for fine-tuning and RL rollouts.

name: Simplismart
what: Platform to deploy and scale generative AI models via API or in the customer's own cloud, supporting 150+ open-source models and custom weights; modular inference stack with custom CUDA kernels and backend optimizations for low latency and high throughput.

name: Together AI
what: Inference cloud for open and custom models (benchmark for the neutral-inference-cloud world).

name: Adaptive ML
what: Reinforcement-learning and post-training platform for tuning open models to enterprise tasks; acquired by Datadog (Harmonic records the M&A on 2026-07-01).

name: Applied Compute
what: Platform for enterprises to train custom models and deploy in-house agent systems on their internal knowledge, using high-performance training infrastructure, reinforcement learning, tailored dataset construction and environment design.

name: Deep Cogito
what: Develops open models aimed at general superintelligence through advances in reasoning and iterative self-improvement.

name: GE Vernova
what: Gas turbine and grid equipment maker; turbine backlog is a proxy for the power bottleneck.
